reason: I already pay about 20 a month for ChatGPT and it does most of my marketing copy and emails. I might try the free plan out of curiosity, but I can't see why I'd pay 59 to 99 euros a month on top of that when I can't tell what it does that copy-pasting doesn't.
objection: I already pay for ChatGPT, what does this add? And 100 credits a month means nothing to me, I have no idea how far that goes before I'm paying more.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it actually keep my CRM updated and follow up with leads by itself for a couple of weeks on the free plan, with a clear idea of what 100 credits gets me.
